profile.summary: I'm a social worker at heart. I'm a professional software engineer by trade. I'm a dad.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Having fun with GraphQL, React Native, Node, Web Components && other cool tools while learning a ton of new skills with Go365 Humana.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
Building and launching multiple real world solutions in the form of mobile applications and PWAs on the night and weekends! 

● ReceiptGold – Mobile receipt management application

          ○ Architected and developed React Native/Expo mobile app with Cloud backend
serving active user base
          ○ Implemented subscription management with RevenueCat including trial periods
and webhook integrations
          ○ Integrated OCR functionality for receipt scanning and automated data extraction
          ○ Managed full App Store submission process and TestFlight beta distribution
          ○ Implemented LLM for additional data/details on receipts.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · React Query · TypeScript · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Node.js · React Native · Apple Certified · Google Play · GraphQL · Jest · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Back-End Web Development · PostgreSQL · Next.js · Git · Jira · Test Driven Development · User Experience (UX) · es6 · SOAP · REST APIs

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built messaging platform with Twilio API integration for SMS/MMS delivery and
real-time status tracking
          ○ Implemented AI-powered content moderation using large language models to
ensure compliance and safety
          ○ Developed toll-free number verification and compliance systems for carrier
requirements
          ○ Created webhook handlers for real-time message status updates and delivery
tracking
          ○ Built scalable backend infrastructure to handle high-volume message processing
          ○ Collaborated with stakeholders to implement feature requests and resolve technical
issues
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Docker · Front-End Development · Vue.js · PHP · SQL

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led Customer Pod sprint refinement and retrospective meetings with
cross-functional teams
          ○ Onboarded and mentored 5+ junior engineers, establishing coding standards
and best practices
          ○ Collaborated with product, design, and backend teams to deliver seamless
user experiences
          ○ Provided technical guidance and code reviews to ensure high-quality
deliverables

● Key Achievements:
          ○ Customer Authentication Redesign: Spearheaded new sign-in flow overhaul
resulting in significant increase in customer satisfaction scores via user
polling
          ○ Accessibility Leadership: Led team to achieve over 90% ADA compliance by
incorporating WCAG standards in all designs, including screen reader
optimization and full keyboard navigation
          ○ Cross-Team Collaboration: Assisted multiple teams with feature
development, architecture decisions, and technical problem-solving
          ○ Participated in on-call rotation supporting production systems and resolving
critical incidents

● Technical Contributions:
          ○ Built reusable component libraries following atomic design principles
          ○ Implemented comprehensive unit and integration testing with Jest and Cypress
          ○ Optimized application performance resulting in improved load times and
user engagement
          ○ Established monitoring and logging practices for proactive issue detection
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Node.js · Oracle E-Business Suite · Jest · TypeScript · React Query · Cypress · React Native · Technology Leadership · Figma (Software)

positions.title: Full Stack Developer at Pursuit (formerly known as C4Q)
positions.description:
Access Code produces high quality web developers through a 10-month curriculum developed and taught by leading experts from companies such as Artsy, Yahoo, FlyLabs and Betaworks.

Accepting only 5% of applicants, the highly selective program prepares graduates with both comprehensive technical training in web development as well as an immersive entrepreneurial and product oriented learning.
